roster.name: Conceived
roster.note: planning begins on a 'Next Generation Space Telescope' to succeed Hubble — the start of a 25-year saga of redesigns, delays, and a budget that grew roughly tenfold

roster.name: Nearly cancelled
roster.note: years behind schedule and billions over budget, the program was targeted for cancellation by Congress before being saved — a survival as narrow as any in this atlas

roster.name: Launch
roster.note: on Christmas Day, an ESA-provided Ariane 5 launches JWST flawlessly — so precisely that the telescope saved enough fuel to roughly double its expected lifetime

roster.name: The unfolding
roster.note: over two weeks, 344 single-point-failure steps deploy the tennis-court sunshield and the segmented mirror a million miles from any hope of repair — every one of them worked

roster.name: First images
roster.note: the first full-colour images stun the world — the deepest infrared view of the universe ever taken, galaxies from the dawn of cosmic time
